meaning.en: To grieve over the state of the world and feel compassion for people's suffering.
meaning.zh: 哀叹时世的艰难，怜悯人们的痛苦。

examples.zh: 他有一颗悲天悯人的心。
examples.en: He has a heart full of compassion for humanity.

examples.zh: 这位作家的作品充满悲天悯人的情怀。
examples.en: The writer's works are full of sorrow and pity for the world.

pinyin: chī bù liǎo dōu zhe zǒu
literal: eat · can't · wrap up · carrying · go

meaning.en: If you can't finish what you have, take it away in your wrap; i.e. you will have to bear the consequences.
meaning.zh: 吃不完的东西用衣襟包着带走；比喻出了问题自己承担后果，没有好下场。

examples.zh: 你要是把事情搞砸了，就等着吃不了兜着走吧。
examples.en: If you botch this, you'll be in for it.

examples.zh: 违规操作，出了事让你吃不了兜着走。
examples.en: Break the rules, and when something goes wrong you'll pay for it.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，带威胁语气，口语。

meaning.en: To cut all ties with someone or something decisively.
meaning.zh: 一刀砍成两段；比喻彻底断绝关系。

examples.zh: 她下决心和旧生活一刀两断。
examples.en: She resolved to make a clean break with her old life.

examples.zh: 他和那帮坏朋友一刀两断了。
examples.en: He cut all ties with that bad crowd.

meaning.en: Beyond cure or rescue; hopelessly bad.
meaning.zh: 病重到无法医治，比喻坏到不可挽救的地步。

examples.zh: 他赌瘾那么大，简直无可救药。
examples.en: His gambling habit is so bad he's simply beyond help.

examples.zh: 别说他无可救药，再给他一次机会。
examples.en: Don't call him hopeless; give him another chance.

meaning.en: Some official position, however minor.
meaning.zh: 泛指不大的官职。

examples.zh: 他读书不为谋取一官半职。
examples.en: He didn't study to win some official post.

examples.zh: 谁不想在单位里混个一官半职呢？
examples.en: Who doesn't want to get some sort of title at work?

usage.en: Object; often 谋个一官半职.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“谋个一官半职”。

literal: rivers · day by day · flow down

meaning.en: Steadily declining, like a river flowing downhill.
meaning.zh: 江河的水一天天向下流；比喻情况一天比一天坏。

examples.zh: 这家老店的生意江河日下。
examples.en: The old shop's business is steadily declining.

examples.zh: 经济每况愈下，行业江河日下。
examples.en: The economy keeps worsening and the industry is going downhill.

meaning.en: Having gone through many hardships; weathered by life.
meaning.zh: 经历了很多艰难困苦。

examples.zh: 老人饱经风霜的脸上刻满了皱纹。
examples.en: The old man's weather-beaten face was etched with wrinkles.

examples.zh: 她一生饱经风霜，却依然乐观。
examples.en: She has been through hard times all her life, yet remains optimistic.

synonyms: 一年三百六十日，风刀霜剑严相逼
antonyms: 温室里的花朵——经不起风雨

meaning.en: Husband and wife living in harmony.
meaning.zh: 丈夫提倡，妻子随同；形容夫妻和睦。

examples.zh: 祝你们夫唱妇随，白头偕老。
examples.en: May you two live in harmony and grow old together.

examples.zh: 他们夫妻夫唱妇随，一起经营小店。
examples.en: The couple run their little shop together in harmony.

literal: hold · malt sugar · play with · grandchildren
natural: enjoy a contented old age with the grandchildren

meaning.en: To enjoy a leisurely old age playing with one's grandchildren.
meaning.zh: 含着糖逗弄孙子，形容老年人安享天伦之乐。

equivalents: enjoy a peaceful old age with the grandchildren
spend one's twilight years doting on grandchildren

examples.zh: 退休后，他在家含饴弄孙，生活悠闲。
examples.en: After retiring he lives at ease at home, playing with his grandchildren.

examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶含饴弄孙，其乐融融。
examples.en: The grandparents dote on the grandchildren in happy harmony.

story.en: Empress Ma, in the Book of the Later Han, says she will only 'enjoy sweets and play with the grandchildren' and no longer meddle in government (吾但当含饴弄孙，不能复关政矣).
story.zh: 《后汉书》：“吾但当含饴弄孙，不能复关政矣。”

meaning.en: Every thread in its place; done with great precision, with every part fitting.
meaning.zh: 织布时每一根经线都穿进筘齿；比喻做得十分细致精确，每个环节都紧密配合。

examples.zh: 这部悬疑剧情节丝丝入扣。
examples.en: The plot of this thriller is tightly woven.

examples.zh: 她的分析丝丝入扣，令人信服。
examples.en: Her analysis was meticulous and convincing.

natural: listen to and believe only one side

meaning.en: To listen to and trust only one side of the story.
meaning.zh: 只听信某一方面的话。

examples.zh: 做领导不能偏听偏信。
examples.en: A leader mustn't listen to only one side.

examples.zh: 他偏听偏信，错怪了好人。
examples.en: He heard only one side and wrongly blamed an innocent person.

meaning.en: The full range of human emotions and desires.
meaning.zh: 泛指人的各种感情和欲望。

equivalents: the whole range of human feelings

examples.zh: 我也是凡人，有七情六欲。
examples.en: I'm only human, with all the usual feelings and desires.

examples.zh: 修行人要克制七情六欲。
examples.en: Those who practise spiritual cultivation must restrain their emotions and desires.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“有七情六欲”。

meaning.en: To overcome the strong and hard by being soft and flexible.
meaning.zh: 用柔和的手段制服强硬的对手。

examples.zh: 太极拳讲究以柔克刚。
examples.en: Tai chi stresses overcoming force with softness.

examples.zh: 她用温和的态度以柔克刚，化解了冲突。
examples.en: She defused the conflict by overcoming hostility with gentleness.

meaning.en: To stay at home with the door shut and not go out.
meaning.zh: 关着门不出去，待在家里。

examples.zh: 疫情期间他闭门不出，在家写作。
examples.en: During the epidemic he stayed shut in, writing at home.

examples.zh: 她失恋后闭门不出，谁也不见。
examples.en: After the break-up she kept to the house and saw no one.

natural: sleep on one's weapons, ready for dawn

meaning.en: To sleep with a weapon for a pillow, waiting for daybreak; always ready for battle.
meaning.zh: 枕着兵器等待天亮，形容时刻警惕，随时准备作战。

equivalents: be ready for action at any moment

examples.zh: 边防战士枕戈待旦，守卫着国门。
examples.en: Border guards stay on constant alert, defending the nation's gate.

examples.zh: 救援队枕戈待旦，随时准备出发。
examples.en: The rescue team is on standby, ready to leave at any moment.

story.en: Liu Kun, in the Book of Jin, wrote that he 'slept with his spear for a pillow awaiting dawn, resolved to destroy the rebel enemy' (吾枕戈待旦，志枭逆虏).
story.zh: 《晋书·刘琨传》：“吾枕戈待旦，志枭逆虏，常恐祖生先吾著鞭。”

natural: break with the old and establish the new

meaning.en: To do away with old ways and set up new ones.
meaning.zh: 破除旧的，建立新的。

equivalents: out with the old and in with the new
clear away the old and build the new

examples.zh: 改革就是要破旧立新。
examples.en: Reform means breaking with the old and establishing the new.

examples.zh: 公司需要破旧立新，才能适应市场。
examples.en: The company needs to clear away old ways to fit the market.

literal: exhaust · bamboo slips · hard · to write

meaning.en: So many crimes that all the bamboo slips in the world could not record them.
meaning.zh: 用尽竹简也写不完，形容罪行极多。

examples.zh: 侵略者在这里犯下的罪行罄竹难书。
examples.en: The crimes the invaders committed here are too many to record.

examples.zh: 这个集团的恶行罄竹难书。
examples.en: The gang's evil deeds are beyond counting.

story.en: Li Mi's denunciation of Emperor Yang of Sui, recorded in the Old Book of Tang: 'Exhaust the bamboo of the Southern Mountains and it still cannot write down his crimes' (罄南山之竹，书罪无穷).
story.zh: 《旧唐书·李密传》：“罄南山之竹，书罪无穷；决东海之波，流恶难尽。”

meaning.en: Two sharp-edged sides meeting head-on, neither giving way.
meaning.zh: 针尖对着麦芒，比喻双方都很尖锐，互不相让。

examples.zh: 两个人一见面就针尖对麦芒。
examples.en: Whenever the two meet they're at daggers drawn.

examples.zh: 双方在会上针尖对麦芒，谁也不让步。
examples.en: The two sides locked horns at the meeting and neither would give way.

literal: not at all · have · doubt · meaning

meaning.en: There is absolutely no doubt.
meaning.zh: 一点疑问也没有，完全肯定。

examples.zh: 这件事他做得对，毫无疑义。
examples.en: He did the right thing, beyond doubt.

examples.zh: 他是这个领域最优秀的专家，毫无疑义。
examples.en: He is unquestionably the best expert in this field.

meaning.en: So much blood shed that it forms a river; a scene of massacre.
meaning.zh: 流出的血汇成了河，形容杀人极多，场面惨烈。

examples.zh: 那场战争让这座城市血流成河。
examples.en: That war turned the city into a bloodbath.

examples.zh: 史书记载，当时战场上血流成河。
examples.en: The histories record that the battlefield ran with blood.

meaning.en: To flirt, teasing and bantering playfully.
meaning.zh: 男女之间用言语或动作调情嬉闹。

examples.zh: 他俩在办公室里打情骂俏，影响很不好。
examples.en: The two flirting in the office makes a very bad impression.

examples.zh: 酒吧里有男女在打情骂俏。
examples.en: Couples were flirting in the bar.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，常含贬义。

meaning.en: Harmful to public morals and decency.
meaning.zh: 败坏社会风气和道德。

examples.zh: 这种演出有伤风化，应予禁止。
examples.en: This kind of show offends public decency and should be banned.

examples.zh: 在公共场所衣着暴露被认为有伤风化。
examples.en: Indecent dress in public places is thought to offend decency.

meaning.en: A red apricot blossom peeping over the wall; a married woman having an affair.
meaning.zh: 本指红色的杏花探出墙外，比喻已婚女子有外遇。

examples.zh: 小说写的是一个红杏出墙的故事。
examples.en: The novel tells of a wife who strays.

examples.zh: 传闻她红杏出墙，其实是误会。
examples.en: Rumour said she was having an affair; it was a misunderstanding.

story.en: Ye Shaoweng's poem 'Unable to Enter the Garden': 'The spring colour cannot be kept in the garden; one branch of red apricot reaches out over the wall' (春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来); the image was later turned into a metaphor for infidelity.
story.zh: 叶绍翁《游园不值》：“春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。”

usage.en: Predicate; humorous or gossipy; usually of women.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，带调侃或八卦色彩，多指女子。
